title: How I improved my Google Gemma 4 31B AI trading bot from -71% in 30D to +70% in 60D
author: fomoz
selftext:
This bot went from $62.61 on June 20 to $18.40 (-71%) on July 24 to $31.27 (+70%) today. This is net of trading fees. It's a small account, this is an experiment. No point putting more $ in a bot that's losing $.

The settings stayed basically the same throughout, with the same strategy. It's trading $HYPE (Hyperliquid coin).

Its goal is to trade like Paul Tudor Jones, looking for asymmetric opportunities. Many small losses, some moderate wins, and a few very large wins. So the PnL curve should look like a staircase, flat or slightly negative between large wins. It does NOT have a high win rate, that's not the goal here.

Yes, crypto rally in the last month helped, but you don't want to have a sawtooth PnL where it just gives up all its gains after its goes sideways. If an AI bot isn't profitable, it won't magically fix itself.

Here's a table with some details:

|Metric, net of trading fees|Before July 24|July 24 → now|
|:-|:-|:-|
|Average win|\+$0.51|\+$0.77|
|Average loss|−$1.09|−$0.22|
|Win rate|13.73%|44.83%|
|Profit factor|0.075|2.81|
|Total trading PnL|−$44.21|\+$12.87|
|ROI|−70.61%|\+69.94%|

So, what did I fix?

I just added memory to this bot. It went from being memoryless to being stateful. That's it.

Now the bot receives these 3 things, in addition to the usual candles, market stats, account info, positions, etc.:

* Previous trade (fill) + reasoning, e.g. BUY or SELL
* Previous decision (BUY, SELL, or HOLD) + reasoning
* Previous campaign, its last decision (a campaign is a full round trip for open to close of a trade)

The rest is patience and letting it run without tweaking settings that can potentially do more harm than good.

Let me know if you have any questions.

I don't think you understand the point he's trying to make, because he is mistaken on the timeline.

I'm not here to show off. This bot was getting destroyed in chop while BTC was going sideways. This bot was going to zero. 

I added memory and it stopped going to zero in chop. Then it made $ when crypto rallied and kept most of its gains.

If this is just luck then we would all randomly either be going broke or make millions. This isn't random.
